name: example
summary: Example: an MCP server behind OAuth - copy this and fill in your own host

connect.description: An MCP server of your choice, signed in with your account

notes: This is a GENERIC example template. Copy it to a new file under ~/.config/gt-lotr/<zone>/connections/
and replace the host, scopes, and flags for your server.
This template carries NO secrets: the OAuth client_id and the refresh-token ref are minted
Set skip_audience_check:true only if your server stamps the token aud as the issuer rather than
the resource (connect then fails with oauth_audience_mismatch without it).
Run `lotr connect <name> --from-template example` in YOUR OWN terminal, not inside Claude Code.
